COUNTEREXAMPLE_IF_DRAIN_IS_INTERPRETED_A: Mission generation G1 has ACTIVE_INTEGRATION I1 bound to G1 and I1 reaches REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS.
MISSION_ROTATION enters, closes gates, increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, and treats old membership/lease authority as drained.

Because the text does not explicitly require I1 to be terminally reconciled and cleared before installing G2, the new mission descriptor can be installed while I1's already-issued external Git CAS remains in flight.
I1 then moves refs/heads/NEXY.AI-Test-AI after the G2 cutover. The intent is stale by generation, but the physical ref side effect has already occurred.
G2 can therefore observe a target changed by a G1 integration across the generation boundary unless rotation is forced to reconcile actual target HEAD before descriptor install/reopen.

AMBIGUITY_ANALYSIS.SAFE_INTERPRETATION: 'drain old authority' includes ACTIVE_INTEGRATION and requires deterministic Git-truth reconciliation to ACTIVE_INTEGRATION == null with healthy integration state before installing G2.
AMBIGUITY_ANALYSIS.UNSAFE_BUT_TEXTUALLY_PLAUSIBLE_INTERPRET: 'drain old authority' means epoch/membership/lease invalidation only; an already-running integration is preserved for later reconciliation while G2 is installed.
AMBIGUITY_ANALYSIS.WHY_BLOCKING: Both interpretations fit the unexpanded phrase in [163], but only the first preserves mission-cutover atomicity. Under [016], mission rotation must fail closed until one canonical meaning/protocol is bound.

REQUIRED_REPAIR: Canonically define MISSION_ROTATION drain to include ACTIVE_INTEGRATION, not only memberships/leases/tasks.
Before installing ACTIVE_MISSION_ID / ACTIVE_MISSION_GENERATION for G2, require ACTIVE_INTEGRATION == null and INTEGRATION_HEALTH == HEALTHY.

If ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS, COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION, REGRESSION, recovery-pending, or UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION, reconcile actual target HEAD and durable Git truth under G1 before generation cutover.
Bind the reconciled target HEAD/TREE into the mission-rotation intent/cutover preconditions so a G1 side effect cannot land after the G2 descriptor snapshot.
Add torture tests for MISSION_ROTATION racing every ACTIVE_INTEGRATION phase and crashes immediately before/after Git CAS.
